verses.display_text: Before the time of his everlasting sleep, he testified before the Lord and His anointed: “I have taken no property—not even sandals—from any human being.” And no person brought an accusation against him.

verses.text: Even after he fell asleep, he prophesied and showed the king his end. He raised his voice from the earth in prophecy to wipe out the people’s lawlessness.
verses.display_text: Even after he fell asleep, he prophesied and showed the king his end. He raised his voice from the earth in prophecy to wipe out the people’s lawlessness.

verses.text: After him Nathan arose to prophesy in David’s days.
verses.display_text: After him Nathan arose to prophesy in David’s days.

verses.text: As fat is set apart from a peace offering, so David was set apart from the sons of Israel.
verses.display_text: As fat is set apart from a peace offering, so David was set apart from the sons of Israel.

verses.text: He played with lions as with young goats, and with bears as with lambs of the flock.
verses.display_text: He played with lions as with young goats, and with bears as with lambs of the flock.

verses.text: In his youth did he not kill a giant and remove reproach from the people, when he raised his hand with a sling stone and brought down Goliath’s pride?
verses.display_text: In his youth did he not kill a giant and remove reproach from the people, when he raised his hand with a sling stone and brought down Goliath’s pride?

verses.text: For he called upon the Lord Most High, and He put strength in his right hand to remove a mighty warrior and raise the horn of His people.
verses.display_text: For he called upon the Lord Most High, and He put strength in his right hand to remove a mighty warrior and raise the horn of His people.

verses.text: Thus they glorified him with tens of thousands and praised him with blessings of the Lord when a crown of glory was brought to him.
verses.display_text: Thus they glorified him with tens of thousands and praised him with blessings of the Lord when a crown of glory was brought to him.

verses.text: For he destroyed enemies all around and reduced his Philistine adversaries to nothing; he shattered their horn to this day.
verses.display_text: For he destroyed enemies all around and reduced his Philistine adversaries to nothing; he shattered their horn to this day.

verses.text: In every deed he gave thanks to the Holy Most High with a word of glory. With his whole heart he sang hymns and loved the One who made him.
verses.display_text: In every deed he gave thanks to the Holy Most High with a word of glory. With his whole heart he sang hymns and loved the One who made him.

verses.text: He stationed psalm singers before the altar, to sweeten the melodies with their sound.
verses.display_text: He stationed psalm singers before the altar, to sweeten the melodies with their sound.

verses.text: He gave festivals splendor and adorned the appointed seasons to their completion, while they praised His holy name and made the sanctuary resound from early morning.
verses.display_text: He gave festivals splendor and adorned the appointed seasons to their completion, while they praised His holy name and made the sanctuary resound from early morning.

verses.text: The Lord took away his sins, raised his horn for ever, and gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.
verses.display_text: The Lord took away his sins, raised his horn for ever, and gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.

verses.text: After him arose a knowledgeable son, who because of him rested in spacious prosperity.
verses.display_text: After him arose a knowledgeable son, who because of him rested in spacious prosperity.

verses.text: Solomon reigned in days of peace; God gave him rest all around, so that he might establish a house for His name and prepare a sanctuary for ever.
verses.display_text: Solomon reigned in days of peace; God gave him rest all around, so that he might establish a house for His name and prepare a sanctuary for ever.

verses.text: How wise you became in your youth! You were filled with understanding like a river.
verses.display_text: How wise you became in your youth! You were filled with understanding like a river.

verses.text: Your soul covered the earth, and you filled it with comparisons containing riddles.
verses.display_text: Your soul covered the earth, and you filled it with comparisons containing riddles.

verses.text: Your name reached distant islands, and you were loved for your peace.
verses.display_text: Your name reached distant islands, and you were loved for your peace.

verses.text: Countries marveled at you for songs, proverbs, comparisons, and interpretations.
verses.display_text: Countries marveled at you for songs, proverbs, comparisons, and interpretations.

verses.text: In the name of the Lord God, who is called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin and multiplied silver like lead.
verses.display_text: In the name of the Lord God, who is called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin and multiplied silver like lead.

verses.text: You bent your loins toward women and were brought under power in your body.
verses.display_text: You bent your loins toward women and were brought under power in your body.

verses.text: You put a blemish upon your glory and profaned your offspring, bringing wrath upon your children and anguish because of your folly,
verses.display_text: You put a blemish upon your glory and profaned your offspring, bringing wrath upon your children and anguish because of your folly,

verses.text: so that the dominion became divided and a disobedient kingdom began from Ephraim.
verses.display_text: so that the dominion became divided and a disobedient kingdom began from Ephraim.

verses.text: But the Lord will never abandon His mercy or let any of His words fail. He will never wipe out His chosen one’s descendants or remove the offspring of the one who loved Him. He gave Jacob a remnant, and David a root from him.
verses.display_text: But the Lord will never abandon His mercy or let any of His words fail. He will never wipe out His chosen one’s descendants or remove the offspring of the one who loved Him. He gave Jacob a remnant, and David a root from him.

verses.text: Solomon rested with his fathers and left after him, from his offspring, the people’s foolishness: Rehoboam, deficient in understanding, who made the people revolt through his counsel.
verses.display_text: Solomon rested with his fathers and left after him, from his offspring, the people’s foolishness: Rehoboam, deficient in understanding, who made the people revolt through his counsel.

verses.text: There was also Jeroboam son of Nebat, who made Israel sin and gave Ephraim a path of sin. Their sins multiplied exceedingly, so that they were removed from their land.
verses.display_text: There was also Jeroboam son of Nebat, who made Israel sin and gave Ephraim a path of sin. Their sins multiplied exceedingly, so that they were removed from their land.

verses.text: They sought out every kind of wickedness, until vengeance came upon them.
verses.display_text: They sought out every kind of wickedness, until vengeance came upon them.

verses.text: Then Elijah arose, a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch.
verses.display_text: Then Elijah arose, a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch.

verses.text: He brought famine upon them and made them few through his zeal.
verses.display_text: He brought famine upon them and made them few through his zeal.

verses.text: By the Lord’s word he held back heaven; in the same way he brought down fire three times.
verses.display_text: By the Lord’s word he held back heaven; in the same way he brought down fire three times.

verses.text: How glorious you became, Elijah, through your wonders! Who can boast of being like you?
verses.display_text: How glorious you became, Elijah, through your wonders! Who can boast of being like you?

verses.text: You raised a dead man from death and from Hades by the word of the Most High.
verses.display_text: You raised a dead man from death and from Hades by the word of the Most High.

verses.text: You brought kings down to destruction and glorious men from their bed.
verses.display_text: You brought kings down to destruction and glorious men from their bed.

verses.text: You heard rebuke at Sinai and judgments of vengeance at Horeb.
verses.display_text: You heard rebuke at Sinai and judgments of vengeance at Horeb.

verses.text: You anointed kings for retribution, and prophets as successors after him.
verses.display_text: You anointed kings for retribution, and prophets as successors after him.

verses.text: You were taken up in a whirlwind of fire, in a chariot with fiery horses.
verses.display_text: You were taken up in a whirlwind of fire, in a chariot with fiery horses.

verses.text: You were recorded in rebukes for appointed times: to still anger before wrath, to turn a father’s heart toward a son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
verses.display_text: You were recorded in rebukes for appointed times: to still anger before wrath, to turn a father’s heart toward a son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.

verses.text: Blessed are those who saw you and those who have fallen asleep in love; for we too will surely live.
verses.display_text: Blessed are those who saw you and those who have fallen asleep in love; for we too will surely live.

verses.text: Elijah was covered by a whirlwind, and Elisha was filled with his spirit. In his days he was not shaken by a ruler, and no one overpowered him.
verses.display_text: Elijah was covered by a whirlwind, and Elisha was filled with his spirit. In his days he was not shaken by a ruler, and no one overpowered him.

verses.text: No word surpassed him, and even in sleep his body prophesied.
verses.display_text: No word surpassed him, and even in sleep his body prophesied.

verses.text: In his life he performed portents, and at his end his works were wondrous.
verses.display_text: In his life he performed portents, and at his end his works were wondrous.

verses.text: Through all these things the people did not repent or turn away from their sins, until they were plundered from their land and scattered throughout all the earth.
verses.display_text: Through all these things the people did not repent or turn away from their sins, until they were plundered from their land and scattered throughout all the earth.

verses.text: The people were left few in number, with a ruler in David’s house. Some of them did what was pleasing, but others multiplied sins.
verses.display_text: The people were left few in number, with a ruler in David’s house. Some of them did what was pleasing, but others multiplied sins.

verses.text: Hezekiah fortified his city and brought water into its midst. With iron he dug through a steep rock and built reservoirs for water.
verses.display_text: Hezekiah fortified his city and brought water into its midst. With iron he dug through a steep rock and built reservoirs for water.

verses.text: In his days Sennacherib came up and sent Rabshakeh, and he departed. He raised his hand against Zion and boasted greatly in his arrogance.
verses.display_text: In his days Sennacherib came up and sent Rabshakeh, and he departed. He raised his hand against Zion and boasted greatly in his arrogance.

verses.text: Then their hearts and hands were shaken, and they suffered pangs like women giving birth.
verses.display_text: Then their hearts and hands were shaken, and they suffered pangs like women giving birth.

verses.text: They called upon the merciful Lord, spreading their hands toward Him. The Holy One quickly heard them from heaven and redeemed them by Isaiah’s hand.
verses.display_text: They called upon the merciful Lord, spreading their hands toward Him. The Holy One quickly heard them from heaven and redeemed them by Isaiah’s hand.

verses.text: He struck the Assyrians’ camp, and His angel destroyed them.
verses.display_text: He struck the Assyrians’ camp, and His angel destroyed them.

verses.text: For Hezekiah did what was pleasing to the Lord and stood strong in the ways of his father David, which Isaiah the prophet commanded, great and faithful in his vision.
verses.display_text: For Hezekiah did what was pleasing to the Lord and stood strong in the ways of his father David, which Isaiah the prophet commanded, great and faithful in his vision.

verses.text: In his days the sun went backward, and He added life to the king.
verses.display_text: In his days the sun went backward, and He added life to the king.

verses.text: With a great spirit he saw the last things and comforted those mourning in Zion.
verses.display_text: With a great spirit he saw the last things and comforted those mourning in Zion.

verses.text: He showed what would happen to the end of the age, and hidden things before they came to pass.
verses.display_text: He showed what would happen to the end of the age, and hidden things before they came to pass.

verses.text: The remembrance of Josiah is like a blend of incense prepared by a perfumer’s skill. In every mouth it will be sweet as honey, and like music at a wine banquet.
verses.display_text: The remembrance of Josiah is like a blend of incense prepared by a perfumer’s skill. In every mouth it will be sweet as honey, and like music at a wine banquet.

verses.text: He was rightly directed in bringing the people back, and he removed the abominations of lawlessness.
verses.display_text: He was rightly directed in bringing the people back, and he removed the abominations of lawlessness.

verses.text: He directed his heart toward the Lord; in days of lawless people he strengthened godliness.
verses.display_text: He directed his heart toward the Lord; in days of lawless people he strengthened godliness.

verses.text: Except for David, Hezekiah, and Josiah, they all committed offenses. For they abandoned the law of the Most High; the kings of Judah came to an end.
verses.display_text: Except for David, Hezekiah, and Josiah, they all committed offenses. For they abandoned the law of the Most High; the kings of Judah came to an end.

verses.text: For they gave their horn to others and their glory to a foreign nation.
verses.display_text: For they gave their horn to others and their glory to a foreign nation.

verses.text: They burned the chosen city of the sanctuary and made its streets desolate,
verses.display_text: They burned the chosen city of the sanctuary and made its streets desolate,

verses.text: by Jeremiah’s hand. For they mistreated him, though he was sanctified in the womb as a prophet to uproot, afflict, and destroy, and likewise to build and plant.
verses.display_text: by Jeremiah’s hand. For they mistreated him, though he was sanctified in the womb as a prophet to uproot, afflict, and destroy, and likewise to build and plant.

verses.text: Ezekiel saw a vision of glory, which He showed him upon a chariot of cherubim.
verses.display_text: Ezekiel saw a vision of glory, which He showed him upon a chariot of cherubim.

verses.text: For He remembered the enemies in a rainstorm, and remembered to do good to those who make their ways straight.
verses.display_text: For He remembered the enemies in a rainstorm, and remembered to do good to those who make their ways straight.

verses.text: May the bones of the twelve prophets flourish again from their place! For they comforted Jacob and redeemed them with the faithfulness of hope.
verses.display_text: May the bones of the twelve prophets flourish again from their place! For they comforted Jacob and redeemed them with the faithfulness of hope.

verses.text: How shall we magnify Zerubbabel? He too was like a seal upon the right hand.
verses.display_text: How shall we magnify Zerubbabel? He too was like a seal upon the right hand.

verses.text: So was Joshua son of Jozadak. In their days they built a house and raised up a holy sanctuary for the Lord, prepared for everlasting glory.
verses.display_text: So was Joshua son of Jozadak. In their days they built a house and raised up a holy sanctuary for the Lord, prepared for everlasting glory.

verses.text: Great also is the remembrance of Nehemiah, who raised our fallen walls, set up gates and bars, and rebuilt our home sites.
verses.display_text: Great also is the remembrance of Nehemiah, who raised our fallen walls, set up gates and bars, and rebuilt our home sites.

verses.text: No one was created on earth like Enoch, for he was taken up from the earth.
verses.display_text: No one was created on earth like Enoch, for he was taken up from the earth.

verses.text: Nor was a man born like Joseph, a leader of his brothers, a support for the people; and his bones were cared for.
verses.display_text: Nor was a man born like Joseph, a leader of his brothers, a support for the people; and his bones were cared for.

verses.text: Shem and Seth were glorified among people, and Adam above every living creature in creation.
verses.display_text: Shem and Seth were glorified among people, and Adam above every living creature in creation.

verses.text: Simon son of Onias, the high priest, repaired the house in his lifetime and strengthened the sanctuary in his days.
verses.display_text: Simon son of Onias, the high priest, repaired the house in his lifetime and strengthened the sanctuary in his days.

verses.text: By him the height of the double wall was founded, a high retaining wall around the sacred precinct.
verses.display_text: By him the height of the double wall was founded, a high retaining wall around the sacred precinct.

verses.text: In his days a water reservoir was hewn out, a cistern whose circumference was like a sea.
verses.display_text: In his days a water reservoir was hewn out, a cistern whose circumference was like a sea.

verses.text: He cared for his people against a fall and strengthened the city against a siege.
verses.display_text: He cared for his people against a fall and strengthened the city against a siege.

verses.text: How glorious he was with the people surrounding him, when he came out from the house of the veil!
verses.display_text: How glorious he was with the people surrounding him, when he came out from the house of the veil!

verses.text: He was like the morning star among clouds, like the full moon in its days,
verses.display_text: He was like the morning star among clouds, like the full moon in its days,

verses.text: like the sun shining upon the sanctuary of the Most High, and like the rainbow gleaming in clouds of glory,
verses.display_text: like the sun shining upon the sanctuary of the Most High, and like the rainbow gleaming in clouds of glory,

verses.text: like a rose blossom in the days of new growth, like lilies beside an outflow of water, like a shoot of Lebanon in summer days,
verses.display_text: like a rose blossom in the days of new growth, like lilies beside an outflow of water, like a shoot of Lebanon in summer days,

verses.text: like fire and frankincense upon a firepan, like a vessel of beaten gold adorned with every costly stone,
verses.display_text: like fire and frankincense upon a firepan, like a vessel of beaten gold adorned with every costly stone,

verses.text: like an olive tree flourishing with fruit, and like a cypress rising into the clouds.
verses.display_text: like an olive tree flourishing with fruit, and like a cypress rising into the clouds.

verses.text: When he took up the robe of glory and clothed himself with the fullness of splendor, as he ascended the holy altar he glorified the sanctuary’s enclosure.
verses.display_text: When he took up the robe of glory and clothed himself with the fullness of splendor, as he ascended the holy altar he glorified the sanctuary’s enclosure.

verses.text: When he received portions from the priests’ hands, standing himself beside the altar hearth, a crown of brothers surrounded him, like a growth of cedars in Lebanon; they encircled him like palm trunks,
verses.display_text: When he received portions from the priests’ hands, standing himself beside the altar hearth, a crown of brothers surrounded him, like a growth of cedars in Lebanon; they encircled him like palm trunks,

verses.text: all the sons of Aaron in their glory, with the Lord’s offering in their hands before the whole assembly of Israel.
verses.display_text: all the sons of Aaron in their glory, with the Lord’s offering in their hands before the whole assembly of Israel.

verses.text: As he completed his ministry at the altars, adorning the offering of the Most High Almighty,
verses.display_text: As he completed his ministry at the altars, adorning the offering of the Most High Almighty,

verses.text: he stretched his hand over the libation vessel and poured a drink offering from the blood of the grape. He poured it at the altar’s foundations, a pleasing fragrance to the Most High, King of all.
verses.display_text: he stretched his hand over the libation vessel and poured a drink offering from the blood of the grape. He poured it at the altar’s foundations, a pleasing fragrance to the Most High, King of all.

verses.text: Then the sons of Aaron cried out and sounded their hammered trumpets. They made a great sound heard as a remembrance before the Most High.
verses.display_text: Then the sons of Aaron cried out and sounded their hammered trumpets. They made a great sound heard as a remembrance before the Most High.

verses.text: Then all the people together hurried and fell facedown upon the earth to worship their Lord, the Almighty God Most High.
verses.display_text: Then all the people together hurried and fell facedown upon the earth to worship their Lord, the Almighty God Most High.

verses.text: The psalm singers praised with their voices; amid a very great sound the melody grew sweet.
verses.display_text: The psalm singers praised with their voices; amid a very great sound the melody grew sweet.

verses.text: The people entreated the Lord Most High in prayer before the Merciful One, until the Lord’s ceremony was completed and they finished His service.
verses.display_text: The people entreated the Lord Most High in prayer before the Merciful One, until the Lord’s ceremony was completed and they finished His service.

verses.text: Then he came down and raised his hands over the whole assembly of the sons of Israel, to give the Lord’s blessing from his lips and to glory in His name.
verses.display_text: Then he came down and raised his hands over the whole assembly of the sons of Israel, to give the Lord’s blessing from his lips and to glory in His name.

verses.text: They bowed down a second time to receive the blessing from the Most High.
verses.display_text: They bowed down a second time to receive the blessing from the Most High.

verses.text: And now bless the God of all, who does great things everywhere, who exalts our days from the womb and deals with us according to His mercy.
verses.display_text: And now bless the God of all, who does great things everywhere, who exalts our days from the womb and deals with us according to His mercy.

verses.text: May He give us gladness of heart, and may there be peace in Israel in our days, throughout the days of eternity.
verses.display_text: May He give us gladness of heart, and may there be peace in Israel in our days, throughout the days of eternity.

verses.text: May He entrust His mercy to us, and in our days may He redeem us.
verses.display_text: May He entrust His mercy to us, and in our days may He redeem us.

verses.text: My soul is disgusted with two nations, and the third is no nation:
verses.display_text: My soul is disgusted with two nations, and the third is no nation:

verses.text: those who sit on Mount Samaria, the Philistines, and the foolish people who dwell in Shechem.
verses.display_text: those who sit on Mount Samaria, the Philistines, and the foolish people who dwell in Shechem.

verses.text: Jesus son of Sirach Eleazar, the Jerusalemite, inscribed instruction in understanding and knowledge in this book; he poured wisdom like rain from his heart.
verses.display_text: Jesus son of Sirach Eleazar, the Jerusalemite, inscribed instruction in understanding and knowledge in this book; he poured wisdom like rain from his heart.

verses.text: Blessed is the one who will occupy himself with these things; by setting them upon his heart he will become wise.
verses.display_text: Blessed is the one who will occupy himself with these things; by setting them upon his heart he will become wise.

verses.text: For if he does them, he will be strong for everything, because the Lord’s light is his path.
verses.display_text: For if he does them, he will be strong for everything, because the Lord’s light is his path.

verses.text: I will give thanks to Thee, Lord and King, and praise Thee, God my Savior. I give thanks to Thy name,
verses.display_text: I will give thanks to Thee, Lord and King, and praise Thee, God my Savior. I give thanks to Thy name,

verses.text: because Thou didst become my shelter and helper. Thou didst redeem my body from destruction and from the snare of a slanderous tongue, from lips that work falsehood. Before those standing around, Thou didst become my helper and redeem me,
verses.display_text: because Thou didst become my shelter and helper. Thou didst redeem my body from destruction and from the snare of a slanderous tongue, from lips that work falsehood. Before those standing around, Thou didst become my helper and redeem me,

verses.text: according to the abundance of Thy mercy and Thy name, from gnashing teeth when I was ready to be devoured, from the hand of those seeking my life, from the many afflictions I had,
verses.display_text: according to the abundance of Thy mercy and Thy name, from gnashing teeth when I was ready to be devoured, from the hand of those seeking my life, from the many afflictions I had,

verses.text: from the choking of a fire all around, and from the midst of a fire that I did not kindle,
verses.display_text: from the choking of a fire all around, and from the midst of a fire that I did not kindle,

verses.text: from the depth of Hades’ belly, from an unclean tongue and a false word—
verses.display_text: from the depth of Hades’ belly, from an unclean tongue and a false word—

verses.text: slander to a king from an unjust tongue. My soul drew near to death, and my life was close to Hades below.
verses.display_text: slander to a king from an unjust tongue. My soul drew near to death, and my life was close to Hades below.

verses.text: They surrounded me on every side, and there was no helper. I looked for support from people, but there was none.
verses.display_text: They surrounded me on every side, and there was no helper. I looked for support from people, but there was none.

verses.text: I remembered Thy mercy, Lord, and Thy work from of old: Thou rescuest those who wait for Thee and savest them from the hand of enemies.
verses.display_text: I remembered Thy mercy, Lord, and Thy work from of old: Thou rescuest those who wait for Thee and savest them from the hand of enemies.

verses.text: I lifted my supplication from the earth and pleaded for deliverance from death.
verses.display_text: I lifted my supplication from the earth and pleaded for deliverance from death.

verses.text: I called upon the Lord, the Father of my Lord, not to abandon me in days of affliction, in a time of arrogance when there was no help. I will praise Thy name continually and sing hymns with thanksgiving.
verses.display_text: I called upon the Lord, the Father of my Lord, not to abandon me in days of affliction, in a time of arrogance when there was no help. I will praise Thy name continually and sing hymns with thanksgiving.

verses.text: My petition was heard, for Thou didst save me from destruction and rescue me from an evil time.
verses.display_text: My petition was heard, for Thou didst save me from destruction and rescue me from an evil time.

verses.text: Therefore I will give thanks to Thee and praise Thee and bless the Lord’s name.
verses.display_text: Therefore I will give thanks to Thee and praise Thee and bless the Lord’s name.

verses.text: While I was still young, before I wandered, I openly sought wisdom in my prayer.
verses.display_text: While I was still young, before I wandered, I openly sought wisdom in my prayer.

verses.text: Before the sanctuary I asked for her, and until the end I will seek her out.
verses.display_text: Before the sanctuary I asked for her, and until the end I will seek her out.

verses.text: From her blossom, as from a ripening grape, my heart rejoiced in her. My foot stepped in uprightness; from my youth I traced her path.
verses.display_text: From her blossom, as from a ripening grape, my heart rejoiced in her. My foot stepped in uprightness; from my youth I traced her path.

verses.text: I inclined my ear a little and received, and found much instruction for myself.
verses.display_text: I inclined my ear a little and received, and found much instruction for myself.

verses.text: I made progress in her; I will give glory to the One who gives me wisdom.
verses.display_text: I made progress in her; I will give glory to the One who gives me wisdom.

verses.text: For I resolved to practice her and was zealous for the good, and I will never be put to shame.
verses.display_text: For I resolved to practice her and was zealous for the good, and I will never be put to shame.

verses.text: My soul has struggled for her, and I was exact in practicing the law. I spread my hands toward the height and mourned my soul’s unwitting faults.
verses.display_text: My soul has struggled for her, and I was exact in practicing the law. I spread my hands toward the height and mourned my soul’s unwitting faults.

verses.text: I directed my soul toward her and found her in purity. From the beginning I gained a heart together with her; therefore I will never be abandoned.
verses.display_text: I directed my soul toward her and found her in purity. From the beginning I gained a heart together with her; therefore I will never be abandoned.

verses.text: My inward parts were stirred to seek her out; therefore I acquired a good possession.
verses.display_text: My inward parts were stirred to seek her out; therefore I acquired a good possession.

verses.text: The Lord gave me a tongue as my reward, and with it I will praise Him.
verses.display_text: The Lord gave me a tongue as my reward, and with it I will praise Him.

verses.text: Draw near to me, you who are uninstructed, and lodge in a house of instruction.
verses.display_text: Draw near to me, you who are uninstructed, and lodge in a house of instruction.

verses.text: Why do you say you are lacking in these things, while your souls thirst exceedingly?
verses.display_text: Why do you say you are lacking in these things, while your souls thirst exceedingly?

verses.text: I opened my mouth and said, “Acquire for yourselves without silver.
verses.display_text: I opened my mouth and said, “Acquire for yourselves without silver.

verses.text: “Put your neck beneath the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction. She is near at hand to be found.
verses.display_text: “Put your neck beneath the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction. She is near at hand to be found.

verses.text: “See with your own eyes that I labored a little and found much rest for myself.
verses.display_text: “See with your own eyes that I labored a little and found much rest for myself.

verses.text: “Take part in instruction at the cost of much silver, and acquire much gold through her.
verses.display_text: “Take part in instruction at the cost of much silver, and acquire much gold through her.

verses.text: “May your soul rejoice in His mercy, and may you not be ashamed in His praise.
verses.display_text: “May your soul rejoice in His mercy, and may you not be ashamed in His praise.

verses.text: “Do your work before the appointed time, and He will give you your reward in His time.”
verses.display_text: “Do your work before the appointed time, and He will give you your reward in His time.”
